description: Source code for a page agent module in Playwright, handling tasks like perform, expect, and extract on web pages, with caching and loop control.

methods.name: pageAgentPerform
methods.description: Performs a user task on a page, possibly using tools, with caching.

methods.name: pageAgentExpect
methods.description: Verifies a condition on a page using assertion tools, with caching.

methods.name: pageAgentExtract
methods.description: Extracts information from a page based on a query and schema.

methods.name: runLoop
methods.description: Main loop to run tools or extraction tasks with API and cache management.

methods.name: cachedPerform
methods.description: Retrieves cached actions and executes them if available.

methods.name: updateCache
methods.description: Updates cache files with current actions.

methods.name: cachedActions
methods.description: Loads cached actions from a cache file.
